notes: Shopify storefront; robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (Allow: /). Discovery: fetched sitemap.xml -> sitemap_collections_1.xml (single, non-paginated file covering all ~250 live collections) and grepped for Christmas/Halloween/Diwali/Easter/Valentine/Thanksgiving/New Year/Indian-festival/Mother's-Father's Day/St Patrick's/Black Friday/Back to School/wedding/season terms; also checked sitemap_pages_1.xml (no seasonal pages) and homepage mega-menu hrefs (Christmas nav not currently live, off-season as of Sep 2026, but the collection pages themselves are still published/reachable). Probed /collections/christmas, christmas-shop, christmas-decorations, christmas-gifts, halloween, diwali, easter, thanksgiving, new-year, holiday-shop, festive-decor, holiday-decor directly -> all 404, confirming no umbrella Christmas parent page and no other holidays exist on this site. Found 10 genuine Christmas PLPs (all slugged luxury-christmas-*) with no shared parent node, so emitted as flat sibling rows under category Christmas rather than inventing a grouping row. Found 1 genuine Valentine's Day PLP (valentines-gift-edit). Excluded: seasonal-scents (og:title/description explicitly Christmas-themed but products.json returned 0 products -> dropped per 0-qty rule), wedding-and-engagement-gifts (life-event/occasion gift page, not a calendar seasonal category), gisela-graham (a designer/brand listing page, not a category, despite the brand being Christmas-focused). Qty source: initial SSR HTML on each collection page render only a generic 'you may also like' recommendation carousel (non-matching products like sofas/dining tables), not the true collection grid, which loads via the site's AJAX filtering app (Fixtuur) -> used the Shopify /collections/<slug>/products.json?limit=250 structured-data endpoint instead (tier 2 qty method) and counted unique product handles; all counts were well under the 250 cap so no further pagination was needed. Cross-checked og:title/og:description and on-page H1 for every candidate to confirm genuine holiday association before inclusion.
